questions.stem: In local infiltration anaesthesia, where does the local anaesthetic act?
questions.answer: Nerve endings close to the injection, within a limited area

questions.stem: Where do peripheral nerve blocks usually target nerve axons, relative to the surgical site?
options: Often far from the surgical site
Just under the skin of the incision

questions.stem: When is local infiltration anaesthesia an option for a surgical procedure?
questions.answer: Any surgery where a specific nerve or plexus block is not possible

questions.stem: What is the main contraindication to local infiltration anaesthesia?
options: Clean, intact skin over the injection site
Patient who is awake and cooperative

questions.stem: In wound infiltration, where is the local anaesthetic deposited?
options: Deep into the muscle beneath the wound
Around the spinal cord in the canal

questions.stem: In a field block, where is the local anaesthetic injected?
options: Into the skin around the surgical site
Into the epidural space at the lumbar level

questions.stem: What reduces the risk of intravascular injection of local anaesthetic during infiltration?
options: Injecting quickly through a large-bore needle
Injecting deeply into the muscle first
Skipping the test before the dose

questions.stem: Which needle gauge reduces the pain of infiltration in an awake patient?
Which measure reduces the pain of infiltration in an awake patient?
options: Cold local anaesthetic straight from the fridge
Injecting quickly through a large-bore needle
Injecting into the same spot repeatedly

questions.stem: How does the duration of local infiltration compare with a nerve block?
options: Much longer than after a nerve block
Much shorter than after a nerve block
About the same as after a nerve block
Slightly longer than after a nerve block

questions.stem: How long does infiltration with ropivacaine last?
How long does infiltration with lidocaine last?
How does a field block anaesthetise a fairly small area?
questions.answer: Injecting a wall of local anaesthetic across the path of its nerves

questions.stem: In a field block, where is the injection placed relative to the operative site?
options: Into soft tissue some distance from the operative site

questions.stem: What advantages does a field block have over direct infiltration?
options: Greater tissue distortion and shorter duration
Longer duration and no distortion of the operative field
Lower total dose and no need for aspiration

questions.stem: Which complication of local infiltration is a toxic reaction to the drug itself?
